description: Building permit application emitted by the gov-municipality permit_submission Pregel cell. Captures project scope + jurisdiction reference + open-source RPC trace (G1) + IPFS-pinned application documents (G2). Distinct from the parent tatekata mission's projectScope: this lexicon is the gov-municipality view of the application AS SUBMITTED to the jurisdiction (it carries the jurisdiction's tracking number and the immutable submission timestamp). Per ADR-2605250800 + gates G1 (open-source RPC), G2 (IPFS-pinned docs), G5 (Charter Rider §2(e) anti-gatekeeping — no commercial permit-broker middleware).

applicationId.description: Stable application identifier; usually the jurisdiction's permit tracking number prefixed with `<jurisdictionCode>:`.

jurisdictionCode.description: ISO-3166-2 subdivision code (e.g. `JP-13` Tokyo, `US-CA` California) plus optional municipality suffix (e.g. `JP-13-Shibuya`).

submitterDid.description: DID of the etzhayyim member submitting the application (project owner or designated agent).

projectScopeIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the project scope bundle (site survey + BOM + construction drawings) at submission time.

buildingType.description: Building class. tatekata R0/R1 scope only covers non-high-rise; high-rise (`commercial-mid-rise`, `commercial-high-rise`) is R3+ per tatekata ADR-2605250730.

grossFloorAreaSqMm.description: Gross floor area in square millimeters (m² × 1,000,000). Per ADR-2605190900 Lexicon convention (integer with implied units).

submittedAt.description: Timestamp the jurisdiction confirmed receipt of the application. Immutable.

jurisdictionRpcAttestationCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the RPC trace (request + response) used to submit. Trace MUST contain only open-source, jurisdiction-published API calls — no proprietary permit-broker middleware (G5).

permitSubmissionCellAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the permit_submission cell's compute attestation.

charterRiderComplianceAttested.description: Structural G5: this application did not route through a commercial permit-broker (Charter Rider §2(e) anti-gatekeeping). Schema rejects false.
